title: Student Transportation Services Fee Table: Permit Fees, Meal-Status Waiver Shares, Household Cap and Payment Terms
content:
The fee figures of Student Transportation Services by transportation type. Only the two courtesy rider permits carry a permit fee; the other five types are fee-free.

## Permit fee and period

| Transportation type | Permit fee | Period one permit fee covers | Credit basis when the district revokes the permit for seat capacity |
|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | 135.00 USD | one semester | prorated by whole months remaining |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | 240.00 USD | the school year | prorated by whole months remaining |
| Regular Route Eligibility | 0.00 USD | not applicable | not applicable |
| Hazardous Route Eligibility | 0.00 USD | not applicable | not applicable |
| Choice Program Hub Shuttle | 0.00 USD | not applicable | not applicable |
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation | 0.00 USD | not applicable | not applicable |
| Special Education Transportation | 0.00 USD | not applicable | not applicable |

## Figures common to every transportation type

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Share of the permit fee waived for a student holding any Free Meal Status tier | 100 percent |
| Share of the permit fee waived for a student holding any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier | 50 percent |
| Maximum courtesy permit fees charged to one household per school year after waivers | 480.00 USD |
| Calendar days after the permit fee posts within which it must be settled before the permit lapses (the posting date is day 0) | 14 |
| Calendar days after the permit start date within which a family cancellation credits the full permit fee (the start date is day 0) | 10 |
| Payment methods accepted for permit and pass fees | online card, ACH bank draft, personal check, money order |
| Calendar days after an assignment ends or is cancelled within which a credit balance is refunded | 30 |

These figures are the same in all seven rows of the type schedule; on a fee-free type they have nothing to act on.

## Points of reading

- **Which fee applies.** A family holding a Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) pays one 240.00 USD fee for the school year; a family on Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) pays 135.00 USD for each semester applied for.
- **Settlement window, both sides (hypothetical dates).** A fee posted on a Monday is day 0; it is within the window through the 14th calendar day after, and the 15th calendar day after is outside it.
- **Full-credit window, both sides (hypothetical dates).** With a start date on day 0, a last day of service on the 10th calendar day after is within the 10-day window; the 11th calendar day after is not.
- **Waiver shares.** On a 135.00 USD fee, 100 percent is 135.00 and 50 percent is 67.50.
